script: Personalise every message. Mention one specific thing you noticed about their business, and keep it under eighty words. Here is a template for a local shop. Hello, I am a Canva designer who helps small food businesses with Instagram posts. I noticed that your bakery posts do not show your new menu. I made a sample post for you, with no obligation. Shall I send it? Here is a template for a former contact. Hi, I hope you are well. I have started offering design help to small businesses from home. If you know anyone who needs help with social media, I would be grateful for an introduction. I am happy to help you too, anytime. Follow up without being pushy. Wait three working days after your first message. Then send one short follow-up that adds value, such as a tip or a free idea. If there is still no reply after a second follow-up, stop and move on. Politeness protects your reputation. Let us look at why a personal message works better than a copy.
